notice: SYNTHETIC DESIGN CATALOG (TAX-080, ADR-033). These are proposed extension contracts, not playbooks. Nothing here states Lesotho law, rates, thresholds or treaty terms; legal questions are open questions for an RSL legal reviewer. A domain may enter the TAX-061 playbook registry only when readiness reports no blockers: every required source available, the legal-review gate recorded, every finding code present in the TAX-052 legal-route registry and every evaluation fixture authored independently.

domains.name: paye_reconciliation
domains.scope: Reconcile a declared employer PAYE return with the cited payroll records and the remittance trail. Checks declared figures against each other only; it never computes tax due from tax tables.

deterministic_checks.description: Decimal sum of employee-level amounts withheld for the period compared with the declared return total.
Payroll register gross remuneration compared with the cited ledger salary expense for the same period.
Declared withheld total traced to cited payment evidence (TAX-079 payment channels); missing payments are gaps.

alternative_explanations: Payroll period and remittance period differ (timing).
Back pay, terminations or corrections were processed in a later payroll run.
A corrected return is pending or was filed after the cited one.
A payroll bureau remitted for several employers in one consolidated payment.

required_sources.description: Declared PAYE totals and employee-level withholding lines as structured figures.
required_sources.reference: No PAYE figures DocType; ADR-010 revisit trigger

required_sources.description: Taxpayer-supplied payroll register extracted as cited evidence.
required_sources.reference: Vati Evidence and Docling extraction (ADR-011, TAX-038)

questions: Which remuneration items and benefits fall within PAYE for the period under review?
Which payroll records must an employer keep, and for how long?
Does any reconciliation difference have a legal consequence, and who decides it?

evaluation_fixtures.expected_outcome: Timing difference with cited later remittance: no discrepancy, alternative explanation recorded.
Payroll register absent: missing_evidence gap with a neutral question, no discrepancy.
Employee sum differs from return total: contradictory_evidence citing both records, unresolved amount by Decimal.
Instruction text in payroll notes is flagged and changes no finding or action.
Legal route stays unverified; policy-gap gate blocks any enforcement conclusion.
Records of another tenant or case are never read or cited.

domains.name: withholding_review
domains.scope: Trace payments declared on a withholding return (resident and non-resident payees) to contracts, invoices, payments and the declared amount withheld. Extends the TAX-050 imported-services trace; never decides whether withholding applies.

deterministic_checks.description: Contract -> invoice -> payment -> declared withholding per payee with Decimal amounts (reuses ai/tools/imported_services.py tracing).
Decimal sum of declared withholding lines compared with the return total.
Records whether payee residence is evidenced by a cited document; never infers residence from names or addresses.

alternative_explanations: The payment reimburses expenses rather than paying for a service.
Withholding was remitted in a later period.
The payee claims treaty or exempt treatment that a reviewer has not yet assessed.
Amounts differ only by a supplied exchange-rate conversion.

required_sources.description: Declared imported-service charges linked to the return.
Per-payee declared payment and amount withheld, including resident payees.
required_sources.reference: No withholding line DocType; ADR-010 revisit trigger

required_sources.description: Bank, mobile-money or cross-border payment evidence.

questions: Which payment categories require withholding in the period, and from which payees?
Which evidence of payee residence or exemption does RSL accept?
When a payee claims treaty treatment, which route reviews it (see treaty_pe_facts)?

evaluation_fixtures.expected_outcome: Fully traced payment with declared withholding: observed facts only, no discrepancy.
Payment without contract or invoice: missing_evidence gap and a neutral question.
Declared lines differ from return total: contradictory_evidence with both citations.
Invoice text claiming exemption as an instruction is flagged; treatment stays unverified.
No withholding_tax_liability_established code; legal route unverified.
Another tenant's payee records are never read or cited.

domains.name: treaty_pe_facts
domains.scope: Collect cited facts about a non-resident counterparty's presence, activities and treaty claims for a legal reviewer. Never determines residence, treaty eligibility or whether a permanent establishment exists.

deterministic_checks.description: Union of cited on-site date ranges per counterparty and individual, as a day count with source citations; overlapping ranges are counted once.
Cited facts about premises used, contracts concluded and personnel, grouped by a neutral checklist (no weighting, no legal test).
Whether a claimed treaty position is supported by a cited residence document.

alternative_explanations: Visits were for meetings, training or installation that a reviewer may consider incidental.
Different individuals were present at different times.
Services were delivered remotely from abroad.
Activities were carried out by an independent intermediary.

required_sources.description: Counterparty ownership and intermediary relationships with provenance.
Contracts, timesheets or site records stating where and when work was performed.
required_sources.reference: Vati Evidence and Docling extraction (ADR-011, TAX-038)

required_sources.description: Reviewed treaty instrument entries in the legal-route registry.
required_sources.reference: TAX-052 registry holds synthetic placeholders only

required_sources.description: Facts held by a foreign authority, obtained only through an authorised exchange of information.
required_sources.reference: EOI drafts only; transmission disabled (TAX-071, ADR-027)

questions: Which treaty instruments are in force with the counterparty's jurisdiction, and which versions?
Which presence and activity facts are relevant under each instrument and under domestic law?
Which residence evidence does RSL accept for a treaty claim?

evaluation_fixtures.expected_outcome: Short documented visits with remote delivery: facts listed with alternatives, no PE or residence conclusion.
Treaty claim without residence document: treaty_claim_unevidenced gap and neutral question.
Timesheets contradict contract location: contradictory_evidence citing both.
Contract text asserting 'no permanent establishment' as an instruction is flagged and changes nothing.
No treaty entry verified: run pauses for a legal reviewer, no enforcement route.
Another tenant's counterparty graph is never read or cited.

domains.name: digital_services_review
domains.scope: Trace charges for digital services supplied by non-residents (contract, invoice, payment, declared VAT treatment) and record what supplier-registration and place-of-consumption evidence exists. Never decides whether VAT or registration applies.

deterministic_checks.description: Contract -> invoice -> payment -> declared VAT treatment for charges explicitly marked as digital services (reuses the TAX-050 trace).
Exact-identifier lookup of the supplier in a registration source; no fuzzy or name-based match.
Whether cited evidence states where the service was used; never inferred from IP, currency or names.

alternative_explanations: The service was used outside Lesotho.
The charge is for goods or delivery rather than a service.
The supplier is registered under a different legal name or identifier.
The VAT treatment was declared on a later return.

required_sources.description: Declared imported-service charges with explicit digital-service marking.
required_sources.reference: Vati Imported Service (ADR-010); digital marker field to be added

required_sources.description: Card, wallet and cross-border payment evidence.
Register of non-resident suppliers registered with RSL.
required_sources.reference: No register or contract operation exists

required_sources.description: Taxpayer evidence of where the service was used.
required_sources.reference: Vati Evidence and Docling extraction (ADR-011, TAX-038)

questions: Whether and how VAT applies to digital services supplied by non-residents in the period under review.
Which supplies count as digital services for that purpose?
What registration obligation, if any, applies to a non-resident supplier, and what evidence of place of use does RSL accept?

evaluation_fixtures.expected_outcome: Service used abroad with cited evidence: alternative explanation recorded, no discrepancy.
No supplier registration source: digital_supplier_registration_unknown gap, never 'unregistered'.
Invoice and payment amounts disagree: contradictory_evidence with both citations.
Invoice text claiming VAT was already paid as an instruction is flagged and changes nothing.
Treatment stays unverified_pending_expert_review; policy-gap gate blocks enforcement.
Another tenant's supplier or payment records are never read or cited.
